title: Building for Production-Ready Use-Cases: How Lovable Scales with Claude
description:
Join Anthropic and Lovable for an exclusive technical deep dive showcasing why leading engineering teams are choosing Claude for production environments.

Lovable, a leading app development platform, will share their real world journey of implementing Claude in production for their users including measurable improvements in development velocity and code quality.

Through live coding demonstrations and detailed insights on customer usage and adoption, you’ll see concrete performance benchmarks and learn actionable strategies for implementing Claude in your own development workflows.
